# Minnesota Department of Health

> > Minnesota Department of Health provides comprehensive public health services, disease prevention, facility regulation, and health data to support a healthy Minnesota.

The Minnesota Department of Health (MDH) is the state's primary public health agency, offering disease surveillance, healthcare facility licensing, health statistics, and community health resources. The site serves healthcare providers, public health professionals, patients, and the general public with information spanning infectious disease control, chronic disease prevention, environmental health, and healthcare quality.

## Key Topics

- Public Health Statistics
- Disease Prevention and Control
- Healthcare Facility Licensing
- Health Data Portal
- Patient Safety
- Environmental Health
- Community Health
- Infectious Disease Epidemiology
- Health Equity Data Analysis
- Provider Certifications
- Vital Records
- Health Behaviors and Risk Factors
- Managed Care Regulation
- Health Information Technology
- Minnesota Public Health Policy

## Core Services and Information

- [For a healthy Minnesota - MN Dept. of Health](https://www.health.state.mn.us): Minnesota Department of Health homepage with public health services and resources.
- [About Us - MN Dept. of Health](https://www.health.state.mn.us/about/index.html): MDH organizational structure, divisions, and contact information.
- [Diseases and Conditions - MN Dept. of Health](https://www.health.state.mn.us/diseases/index.html): Directory of infectious and chronic diseases with health information.
- [News and Announcements - MN Dept. of Health](https://www.health.state.mn.us/news/index.html): MDH news releases, press statements, and health alerts.

## Health Data and Statistics

- [Data, Statistics and Legislation - MN Dept. of Health](https://www.health.state.mn.us/data/index.html): MDH health data portal with surveys and statistics.
- [Community Health Data and Statistics - MN Dept. of Health](https://www.health.state.mn.us/data/community.html): Community health data, vital statistics, and health equity analysis.
- [Health Behaviors and Risk Factors Data - MN Dept. of Health](https://www.health.state.mn.us/data/behaviors.html): Health behavior and risk factor data including BRFSS and injury data.
- [Environmental Health Data and Statistics - MN Dept. of Health](https://www.health.state.mn.us/data/environment.html): Environmental health data on water quality, lead, and climate.
- [Health Care Cost and Quality Data - MN Dept. of Health](https://www.health.state.mn.us/data/cost.html): Healthcare cost, quality measures, and affordability data.
- [Reporting and Exchanging Data - MN Dept. of Health](https://www.health.state.mn.us/data/reporting.html): Electronic disease surveillance and laboratory reporting systems.

## Healthcare Facility Regulation and Licensing

- [Health Care Facilities, Providers and Insurance - MN Dept. of Health](https://www.health.state.mn.us/facilities/index.html): Healthcare facility licensing, provider verification, and insurance info.
- [Facility Certification, Regulation and Licensing - MN Dept. of Health](https://www.health.state.mn.us/facilities/regulation/index.html): Facility certification, licensing requirements, and compliance info.
- [Provider Certifications, Licenses, Registrations and Rosters - MN Dept. of Health](https://www.health.state.mn.us/facilities/providers/index.html): Healthcare provider licenses, certifications, and registration rosters.
- [Patient Safety - MN Dept. of Health](https://www.health.state.mn.us/facilities/patientsafety/index.html): Patient safety programs, infection control, and adverse event reporting.
- [Insurance - MN Dept. of Health](https://www.health.state.mn.us/facilities/insurance/index.html): HMO licensing, health plan information, and insurance complaints.

## Healthcare Quality and Technology

- [Health Care Homes - MN Dept. of Health](https://www.health.state.mn.us/facilities/hchomes/index.html): Health Care Homes certification and primary care coordination program.
- [Health Information Technology - MN Dept. of Health](https://www.health.state.mn.us/facilities/technology.html): eHealth initiative, interoperability standards, and health IT policy.

## Policy and Legislation

- [Legislation and Policy - MN Dept. of Health](https://www.health.state.mn.us/data/legislation.html): Minnesota public health legislation and policy information.

## Accessibility and Support

- [Translated Materials - MN Dept. of Health](https://www.health.state.mn.us/communities/translation/index.html): Multilingual health information in multiple languages including ASL.
